title: Projektetage Column Text Morph
description: Fix projektetage tiles-to-text transition: all column tiles should morph into one shared label per column (not first tile to text then text to stack). Use column ghost bridge slide and columnMorphId labels.
summary:
Tiles now morph into fixed column labels; label text no longer animates.

Root cause: hidden column ghosts had h2 with the same label text as the target slide. reveal.js text matching paired those headings and moved the text, while tiles only followed secondarily.

Fix: removed ghost rendering for columnMorphTiles splits; labels use morphColumnGroups with empty per-tile tileMorphId sinks at the stack position plus a separate heading (no data-id on h2). Each tile FLIP-morphs into its sink; headings stay fixed at the final stack layout.
